required.name: title
required.label: Document title
required.why: The agent cites the document by name, and reference material is quoted far more often than it is summarised.

required.name: updated
required.label: Last updated
required.why: A policy, spec, or procedure is only usable if the agent can say which version of it the user is being told about.

required.name: authority
required.label: Published by
required.why: The agent has to say whose rule this is, because a document with no named publisher is not evidence of anything.

recommended.name: description
recommended.label: Summary
recommended.why: Gives the agent your framing of what the document covers instead of the first paragraph it happens to hit.

recommended.name: primary-action-url
recommended.label: Apply, download, or start link
recommended.why: Most reference documents exist to send someone somewhere; the link is the step the agent is trying to find.

recommended.name: section
recommended.label: Section
recommended.why: Places the document in its collection so the agent can find the sibling it actually needed.
